Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.SurgebindingAb.label: Mold Armor
Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.SurgebindingAb.description: Run Cohesion through your clothing and armor, reshaping the material at a fundamental level. Leather hardens. Cloth tightens into something denser than it was. Even the simplest garments gain a resilience that surprises anyone who strikes them. The effect fades, but while it lasts, you wear something that was never meant to be armor and somehow is.
